cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your coat off. This bell-less tower is meant to ring at noon. You timed my experiments for years; I need a witness who knows the routine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Write silence, not failure; observation before conclusion, remember? Sign it before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then four minutes more. You still rush the finish. I'll fill in our names; you keep watching the time, properly this once.
